prompt:
Create a production 2D sprite atlas for a French fan RPG with realistic HD prerendered character sprites, not pixel art and not chibi. Use the attached existing NPC atlas only as an identity, material and lighting reference for its TOP ROW THIRD CHARACTER: Joker, the young adult male Normandy SR-1 pilot in Mass Effect 1, short brown beard, dark navy pilot cap, navy Alliance uniform with rolled sleeves and subtle muted gold piping. Do not reproduce the other people or the reference background.

OUTPUT: a native 1536 by 1024 RGBA PNG with truly transparent background, exactly TWO separate full-body seated poses, SIDE BY SIDE. LEFT CELL = idle, RIGHT CELL = pilot. Both show the same man and exactly the same simple compact dark futuristic pilot chair. The chair and its feet/base are part of each sprite. Leave a broad completely transparent vertical gutter centered around x=768, at least 110 pixels wide. Leave generous transparent margins on all outer edges. Each full silhouette, including cap, hands, complete bent legs, both boots, chair back, chair base and floor contacts, must fit independently without touching any cell edge. No labels, numbers, text, border, divider, floor, scenery, cockpit architecture or shadows outside the sprite.

VIEW: fixed orthographic three-quarter view from slightly above, the pilot and chair face toward screen-right, with face and chest readable. Match the adult realistic proportions, fine fabric material, navy palette, soft upper-left key light and neutral detailed HD rendering of the reference. The two figures must be the same size and camera angle, with grounded chair base and boots on a shared baseline around y=940. The pose must be unmistakably SITTING, hips resting on seat, knees bent about 90 degrees, boots in front of the seat and no standing anatomy. Use a modest low-profile futuristic chair, not a throne or a tall mechanical exosuit. Do not add new equipment or weapons.

LEFT IDLE: relaxed neutral seated pilot, head slightly turned toward the viewer while torso and chair face screen-right, hands resting separately on chair armrests, shoulders calm. RIGHT PILOT: same chair and body proportions, head attentive toward screen-right, both forearms moved modestly forward, hands on small controls integrated into the chair armrests, hands and chair must not obscure face or legs. Keep this a subtle readable two-pose variation, not a movement cycle. The complete navy cap and restrained Alliance-era clothing must be consistent in both poses. This is a prototype seated-pose family; preserve the attached prototype identity rather than substituting a later-game uniform.

SECOND REFERENCE: the Prima Mass Effect 1 guide page printed 62. Only the SMALL TOP-LEFT GAME SCREENSHOT is relevant: the foreground man in the dark cap is Joker seated at the Normandy controls, while the other bridge figure in the background is Kaidan. Use this screenshot as a limited check on Joker's seated posture, cap and understated pilot clothing; do not reproduce the page, text, background crew, screenshots or cockpit. The full chair and lower body remain a prototype interpretation. The primary reference is not a later-game Cerberus uniform: exclude white/orange Cerberus insignia and armour.
